powers.title: Arcane Transport
powers.description: You extend your magic to include a nearby friend as you step through an unseen, arcane corridor.
rows: Trigger: You teleport using a swordmage power
Target: One ally in the burst
Effect: The target teleports to a space adjacent to the space you teleport to.

powers.title: Channeling Shield
powers.description: You throw up a temporary shield to absorb some of the power of a foe's attack.
rows: Trigger: An attack hits you or an ally within 10 squares of you
Target: The creature hit by the triggering attack
Effect: You reduce the damage the target takes from the triggering attack by 5 + your Constitution.
Aegis of Shielding: The next successful attack you make before the end of your next turn deals extra damage equal to your Constitution.

powers.title: Dimensional Warp
powers.description: You reach out with arcane power, and two of your nearby allies suddenly wink out and reappear in each other's places.
rows: Target: You and one ally in the burst or two allies in the burst
Effect: Each target teleports into the other's space. Both targets must occupy the same size space, or the power fails.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 28.

powers.title: Eldritch Speed
powers.description: Eldritch power flows in your blood, and when battle is joined, the power speeds you on.
rows: Effect: Use this power before rolling initiative. You gain a +5 power bonus to your initiative roll. You can take an extra move action during the first round of combat (or during the surprise round, if you are allowed to act during that round).
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 28.

powers.title: Elemental Aegis
powers.description: You raise an aegis in your ally's defense, infusing the shield with elemental energy to help defend against certain attacks.
rows: Trigger: An enemy you have marked attacks an ally.
Target: One ally in the burst.
Effect: Choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Your ally gains resistance to that damage type equal to 5 + your Constitution until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Fear No Elements
powers.description: The elements of the universe are yours to command, and they do not easily damage you.
rows: Effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Until the end of the encounter, you gain resist 5 + your Constitution to that damage type.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 28.

powers.title: Ghost Step
powers.description: Like a ghost, you glide unharmed through the battlefield.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, whenever you shift, you can shift 1 additional square.

powers.title: Host of Shields
powers.description: Your weapon produces a few small, glowing shields that orbit your body and ward off blows.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain a +2 power bonus to AC and Reflex.

powers.title: Mythal Recovery
powers.description: You focus your warding inward to bolster yourself against the onslaught.
rows: Effect: Make a saving throw against an effect that a save can end.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 28.

powers.title: Price of Ensnarement
powers.description: Your attacks punish those who cannot escape your reach.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain a +2 power bonus to damage rolls against slowed or immobilized targets.
Aegis of Ensnarement: You also gain a +1 power bonus to attack rolls against slowed or immobilized targets.

powers.title: Spellbinder's Gift
powers.description: A ring of magical energy washes out from you, clinging to your allies' weapons.
rows: Target: Each weapon you or an ally is wielding in the burst
Effect: Choose fire, cold, lightning, or force. The targeted weapon deals this kind of damage until the end of your next turn.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Ward of Brilliance
powers.description: A brilliant flash of light shields you and blinds your foe.
rows: Trigger: An enemy marked by you hits you with a melee attack

Effect: You gain a +4 power bonus to AC and Reflex until the end of your next turn. If the triggering enemy's attack hits you despite the bonus, the triggering enemy is blinded until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Armathor's Step
powers.description: Arcane power speeds you into battle.
rows: Effect: Teleport 5 squares. If you end this move adjacent to an enemy, you gain a +2 power bonus to the next attack roll you make against that enemy during your turn.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 29.

powers.title: Dimensional Warding
powers.description: Your warding warps the flow of magic around you, preventing enemies from sneaky escapes or attacks.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone that lasts as long as the stance persists. Enemies within the zone cannot teleport. Enemies outside the zone cannot teleport into it.
Special: The zone remains centered on you, even if you move.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 29.

powers.title: Eldritch Quagmire
powers.description: Your spell turns the ground beneath your enemies' feet into gooey mud, which grasps and slows their movement.
rows: Effect: You activate an aura 2 that lasts until the end of the encounter or until you deactivate it as a free action. The ground in the aura is difficult terrain for your enemies.
Aegis of Ensnarement: When you deactivate the aura, one enemy within 2 squares of you is immobilized until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Fate-Spurned Foe
powers.description: Forces beyond your enemy's comprehension work against it at your command.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, any effect that a save can end that you place on an enemy causes a –2 penalty to saving throws against the effect.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 29.

powers.title: Nimbus of Shielding
powers.description: You extend a magical ward around nearby allies.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, your allies gain a +1 power bonus to AC while adjacent to you.
Aegis of Shielding: Allies instead gain a +1 power bonus to all defenses while adjacent to you.

powers.title: Quickling Stride
powers.description: You move through the battlefield in a blur.
rows: Effect: You move 12 squares.

powers.title: Silversteel Veil
powers.description: You raise a magical ward of thin, wispy silver mist. It seems no more tangible than warm breath on a frosty morning, but it gathers under enemy blows and turns them aside.
rows: Targets: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: All affected creatures gain a +2 bonus to AC and Reflex defense until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 29.

powers.title: Stride of the Gallant
powers.description: With the rush of wind, you blink to your enemy's side, darting around the battlefield in a swirl of sword and spell.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain teleport 3 as an additional movement mode, but you must end such teleports adjacent to an enemy.

powers.title: Swordmage's Decree
powers.description: Speaking ancient words of aegis binding, you lower a mantle of magic over your enemies that marks them as your foes.
rows: Target: Each enemy in the blast

Effect: The target is marked by your Swordmage Aegis power. Marking the target does not remove the mark on another target already affected by your Swordmage Aegis. If you mark only one target with this power, you do not expend the power but cannot use it again during this encounter.

powers.title: Unicorn's Touch
powers.description: Your blade briefly adopts the appearance of a unicorn horn, sending out a focused pulse of curative energy.
rows: Target: You or one ally in the burst
Effect: The target either rolls a saving throw or regains hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution.

powers.title: Variable Defense
powers.description: You summon the strength of the elements to shield you from damage.
rows: Effect: Choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. You have resistance to that damage type equal to your Constitution. As a minor action, you can change the type of resistance to any other listed damage type. This resistance lasts until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Zephyr of the Barren Sands
powers.description: You channel the power of the desert winds to briefly lift you into the air.
rows: Effect: You fly a number of squares equal to your speed.

powers.title: Arcane Awareness
powers.description: Arcane power guides your defensive posture, guarding you even from attacks you can't see coming.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you do not grant combat advantage to any of your enemies.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 30.

powers.title: Armor of Assault
powers.description: The magic of your vicious attacks temporarily protects you from harm.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, when you hit with a melee weapon attack you gain a +1 power bonus to all defenses until the start of your next turn.
Aegis of Assault: Increase the power bonus to +2.

powers.title: Dimensional Dodge
powers.description: As the enemy prepares to riddle you with arrows from afar, you vanish and reappear right next to it.
rows: Trigger: An enemy within 20 squares of you hits you with a ranged attack.
Effect: You teleport adjacent to the enemy.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 30.

powers.title: Feywild Grace
powers.description: You move with otherworldly grace through even the most difficult environments.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain a +2 power bonus to speed and a +2 power bonus to Athletics checks, Acrobatics checks, and Stealth checks, and you ignore difficult terrain.

powers.title: Impenetrable Warding
powers.description: The air shimmers about you and thickens against enemy assault. The mythal protects you, always.
rows: Effect: Your warding provides its bonus to all your defenses, not just AC.
powers.source: Published in Forgotten Realms Player's Guide, page(s) 31.

powers.title: Like a Feather
powers.description: You fear no height, for your magic gives grace to any landing.
rows: Trigger: You are knocked prone or fall
Effect: You take no falling damage, and you are not knocked prone.

powers.title: Spider's Leap
powers.description: Like the deathjump spider, you can pounce upon your prey with frightening speed.
rows: Effect: You make an Athletics check to jump with a +10 power bonus. You are considered to have a running start and can move as far as the check allows.
Aegis of Ensnarement: When you charge, you can use this power as a free action.

powers.title: Unerring Vision
powers.description: Your eyes glow silver, piercing the veils that separate you and your opponent.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you are automatically aware of each creature within 5 squares of you, including those that are hidden or invisible. You know the squares that any of those creatures occupy, but this knowledge does not negate the effects of cover, superior cover, concealment, or total concealment.
